scope: C++ joint transaction framework, real VPR closure, paired sequential/interleaved development evaluation

gates.requirement: Atomic placement/site/route/resource state, endpoint remapping, timing barrier, version conflicts, bounded repair, deterministic replay
gates.evidence: 113 C++ checks including weight-dependent tree attachment, PR/empty-tree equivalence and retained branch invariance; full native publication audits

gates.requirement: Real VPR case with moved placement, PR C-model candidate routing, native placement/routing validation and repeated semantic outputs
gates.evidence: Three-design nine-evaluation feedback study: 30 runs, 85 QoR commits, 185 aborts, 115 timing barriers; five-repeat full-state/event/timing determinism; independent state and budget audits; frozen independent cohort: four supported designs, 80 host runs, eight publication audits, 35 QoR commits; two additional designs fail root-clock conversion and remain coverage failures

gates.requirement: Same-component sequential/shared/interleaved/repair comparison including all initialization, copying, validation and fallback costs
gates.evidence: Same retained-router staged controls completed; matched nine-evaluation feedback changes alu4 WL/CPD tradeoff but does not improve ex5p/misex3 final QoR; PR full reroute remains outside common CPD gate; 54 timing-weight runs preserve all old weight-zero semantics; weighted full rerouting improves CPD but misses WL gate; 132 non-overlapping validation cost ledgers audited; cache changes preserve 630 native-file comparisons; TP best-visited strong reference adds 75 canonical placement checks but has a 24-closure budget; fresh 15-run TP nine-closure reference passes 135 native closure audits and repeated full-trajectory comparison; common final objective favors TP on ex5p/misex3 and FP on alu4; no paired timing claim; independent cohort: all four shared staged/interleaved pairs unchanged in quality; nine-evaluation feedback worse on three designs and equal on one, with no universal gain

claim_limits: Local refinement starts from a legal routed design and does not establish full P&R from packed input
No speedup claim from synthetic tests or stage-only timing
Existing TP move/rollback machinery is prior component work
Protocol-only commits are excluded from QoR/performance evidence

completed_increments.feature: bounded failure-to-placement repair, immutable snapshots, feedback provenance and native delay bridge
completed_increments.result: 79 unit checks and three-design native development audits pass; zero QoR-accepted commit

completed_increments.feature: Explicit retained-tree FP controller using unchanged PR search/commit kernels, exact per-net ownership, paired empty-tree control and native IO serialization repair
completed_increments.result: Local development QoR improvements reproduced; no independent fusion/speedup claim

completed_increments.feature: Same retained-router staged controls and reproduced frozen TP followed by priority-aligned fixed-placement PR
completed_increments.result: 45 protected controller runs and 15 legality-only PR runs re-audited; no universal interleaving benefit; all full-reroute PR outputs exceed common CPD gate

completed_increments.feature: Retained-router feedback repair consumes the same total evaluation budget as blind HPWL candidate selection
completed_increments.result: 30 nine-evaluation runs, five repeats per mode/design; 85 QoR commits and 60 repair attempts; native/state/budget audits and two negative auditor controls pass; only alu4 has lower final WL with feedback, at higher CPD than blind control

completed_increments.feature: Explicit common upstream tree-timing weight and non-overlapping native validation cost ledger
completed_increments.result: 113 checks and 54 runs audited; all weight-zero state/event/timing outputs reproduce archives; full weight improves PR CPD but violates common WL gate in all three cases; controller effects mixed; default unchanged; RR XML decode accounts for 35.04% of 132 profiled validation bodies

completed_increments.feature: Immutable complete-CSR RR export metadata with native byte equality and full preparation charging
completed_increments.result: 60 runs, 90 paired native validations and 630 byte comparisons pass; 40 QoR commits, 80 aborts, 100 timing barriers; host faster but charged short-batch totals worse; default XML retained

completed_increments.feature: Common-final-objective selection over all 24 native TP trials per design, including TP rejections
completed_increments.result: All 75 original/visited layouts independently checked against common contract; 72 proposal/canonical coordinate comparisons; selected trials 5/20/20 all rejected by TP online policy; full 24-closure cost retained; no equal-budget claim

completed_increments.feature: Fresh frozen TP nine-closure reference with common final quality selector and five complete invocations per design
completed_increments.result: 15 new invocations, 135 legal native candidate closures and five-repeat full trajectory determinism; same initial net/place/route as FP; TP wins final WL on ex5p/misex3, FP wins on alu4; internal objectives/work units differ and timings are not paired

completed_increments.feature: Frozen six-input validation with preserved input failures and complete final analysis
completed_increments.result: All 12 suites attempted; eight audited, four root-clock conversion failures, support 4/6; 80 host runs, 35 QoR commits, 405 aborts, 115 timing barriers, 105 repairs; no general fusion benefit

follow_up_research: Implement explicit ignored-net membership and serialization before expanding root-clock support; preserve the archived coverage failures
Profile candidate enumeration separately, then evaluate improved TP/RC policies under newly frozen protocols and validation inputs
Decide hardware partition, transaction pool and binary/HBM ABI from measured footprints only after algorithm and cost evidence justify it
